title: Handwritten TL Hex8 J2 plastic reference kernel
objective: Extend elastic reference with radial return mapping, power-law hardening, history variables, and consistent tangent for J2 plasticity.

plan_assets.asset_description: Physical benchmark suite including Cook's membrane and necking bar

implementation_steps: Implement von Mises yield function with power-law hardening sigma_y(alpha) = sigma_y0 + K*alpha^n
Implement algorithmic consistent tangent (elastic + plastic branches)
Add history variable storage (equivalent plastic strain, back stress if needed)
Wire converged-step commit for history variables
Verify below-yield equality to elastic reference
Verify yield-surface residual near machine precision
acceptance_criteria: Below-yield loading produces results identical to elastic reference (P1.1)

cases: Hardening curve: sigma_y increases with plastic strain

risks: Return mapping convergence for large strain increments — use adaptive substepping if needed
Consistent tangent derivation error — verify with finite differencing
